source: Wiktionary 'beachie': a beach break (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/beachie)
Wiktionary 'pointbreak': alternative form of point break (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/pointbreak)
Wiktionary 'river mouth' (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/river_mouth); spot data spells it 'Rivermouth' (https://swelleye.com/en/surf-spots/donghe)

Wiktionary 'sandbar': ridge of sand caused by waves along a shore (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/sandbar); Wikipedia: beach breaks often break on a sandbar (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_surfing)
Wiktionary 'sandy': covered with sand; containing sand (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/sandy); needed because the stemmer keeps 'sandi' and 'sand' apart
Wiktionary 'novice': a beginner (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/novice)
Wiktionary 'newbie': someone extremely new and inexperienced; a beginner (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/newbie)
Wiktionary 'learner': one who is learning (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/learner)
Wiktionary 'first-timer': a person engaging in any activity for the first time (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/first-timer)
Wiktionary 'first-timer' (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/first-timer)

Wiktionary 'kook' (surfing): a boardsport participant who lacks skill; a newbie (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/kook); Independent Surfer: a term used for a beginner surfer (https://independentsurfer.com/glossary-of-surfing-terms-and-surf-slang/)

Surf schools offer lessons and equipment rental (https://www.twosevenths.com/en/outdoors/kenting-watersport-guide/); lessons are sold as beginner surf lessons (https://www.seeksophie.com/experiences/kenting-1-day-beginner-surf-lesson-owe5ov97jo)

Wiktionary 'expert': a person with extensive knowledge or ability (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/expert); spot data uses 'Advanced - Pro' and 'Experienced +' levels (https://swelleye.com/en/surf-spots/chenggong)
Wiktionary 'experienced': having experience and skill in a subject (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/experienced)
Wiktionary 'mal' (surfing): a longboard (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/mal)
Wiktionary 'malibu' (surfing): a lightweight longboard (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/malibu)
Wiktionary 'log' (surfing slang): a heavy longboard (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/log)
Wiktionary 'longboarding': surfing with a longboard (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/longboarding)

Wikipedia Glossary of surfing: barrel (also tube, cave, keg, green room) (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_surfing); Independent Surfer: a wave that is hollow (https://independentsurfer.com/glossary-of-surfing-terms-and-surf-slang/)
Wiktionary 'tube' (surfing): a wave that pitches forward, creating a hollow space (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/tube); Wikipedia Glossary of surfing (barrel = tube)
Independent Surfer: a barrel is a wave that is hollow (https://independentsurfer.com/glossary-of-surfing-terms-and-surf-slang/)
Wikipedia Glossary of surfing: glassy = extremely smooth, not disturbed by wind; offshore wind makes a glassy surface (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_surfing)
Wikipedia Glossary of surfing: mushy = a wave with very little push (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_surfing)
Wikipedia Glossary of surfing: blown out = rendered too choppy by wind; onshore wind creates choppy, messy waves (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_surfing)
Wikipedia Glossary of surfing: close-out = breaks everywhere along the face at once (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_surfing)
Wikipedia Glossary of surfing (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_surfing)
Wikipedia Glossary of surfing: A-frame = a peak that lets surfers go either left or right (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_surfing)
Wiktionary 'rip': a strong, rough tide or current (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/rip)
Wikipedia Glossary of surfing: riptide = a strong offshore current (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glossary_of_surfing)
Wiktionary 'hire' (chiefly UK): to rent (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/hire)
Wiktionary 'rental': something that is rented; a business that rents something out (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/rental)
Wiktionary 'secluded': hidden, isolated, remote (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/secluded)
Wiktionary 'uncrowded': not crowded (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/uncrowded); profiles describe uncrowded spots as remote or in relative solitude (https://swelleye.com/en/surf-spots/zhuan)
Wiktionary 'restroom': a room containing a public toilet (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/restroom)
Wiktionary 'bathroom': a room containing a shower or bathtub and typically a toilet (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/bathroom)
Wiktionary 'washroom': a room with a toilet, particularly a public toilet (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/washroom)
Wiktionary 'car park': synonym of parking lot (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/car_park)
Wiktionary 'car park' synonyms (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/car_park)
